decisive_spans.text: Serum parvovirus B19 (PVB19) IgM and IgG antibodies were detectable
PVB19 DNA was found (viral load of 0.2 PVB19 DNA copies/β-globin gene copy, or 33,438 copies/μg of isolated DNA) in lesional skin biopsy specimen

response.rationale: The presence of detectable PVB19 IgM and IgG antibodies and PVB19 DNA in lesional skin biopsy specimen strongly supports Parvovirus B19 infection. Other candidates are less likely due to contradictory findings or lack of specific support.
